reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for uploading, configuring, enabling, disabling, and removing per-profile Web UI background images with separate light and dark mode overlays.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供按配置文件管理背景图片、预览图片并分别调整浅色和深色模式遮罩的插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing per-profile Web UI background images, previewing them, and adjusting separate light and dark mode overlays.

capabilities: uploads and validates background image files
stores one background image and settings per Harness profile
serves the selected image through a plugin route
